newsitem.title: GREECE: ATTICA ENTERPRISES SAYS PROFITS UP 42PCT IN JAN-SEP.
newsitem.headline: ATTICA ENTERPRISES SAYS PROFITS UP 42PCT IN JAN-SEP.

text.p: Greek shipper Attica Enterprises said in a statement that its net income rose 42.1 percent year-on-year to 3.710 billion drachmas in the first nine months of 1996 and its sales surged 81.2 percent to 10.9 billion.
Profits before interest and depreciation rose 45.2 percent year-on-year in the same period.
The firm said its consolidated net income will exceed 4.0 billion drachmas in 1996 beating its May 1995 prospectus of 3.2 billion, it said.

Its Superfast I and II passenger and vehicle ferries which provide links between the western port of Patras and Italy's Adriatic port of Ancona seized a 43.4 percent market share in passenger traffic, 41.6 percent in truck traffic and 37.8 percent in private cars and trailers.
A total of 12 ships are active in the Patras-Ancona-Patras line, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
